BETTERREWARDS-EVENT.title: Event
BETTERREWARDS-HP_SACRIFICE_PERCENT.title: HP Sacrifice %
BETTERREWARDS-HP_SACRIFICE_PERCENT.hover: Fraction of your current HP lost per sacrifice (0.0–1.0). Capped so a single choice cannot exceed 1/N of your max HP.
BETTERREWARDS-SACRIFICE_REPEAT_COUNT.hov: How many times you may sacrifice HP for gold.
BETTERREWARDS-SCORE_TO_GOLD_PERCENT.hove: Fraction of your previous run's score converted to gold per sacrifice (e.g. 0.25 = 25% of score per sacrifice).
BETTERREWARDS-MIN_PREVIOUS_SCORE.title: Minimum Previous Score
BETTERREWARDS-MIN_PREVIOUS_SCORE.hover.d: The effective previous-run score is at least this value, guaranteeing a minimum gold opportunity even on the first run.
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL.title: Shop reroll
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL_BASE_COST.hove: Gold cost for the first shop reroll.
BETTERREWARDS-SHOP_REROLL_COST_SCALING.h: Multiplier applied to reroll cost after each use (e.g. 1.10 = +10% each time).
BETTERREWARDS-RANDOM_RELIC.title: Random relic
BETTERREWARDS-RELIC_BASE_COST.title: Random Relic Base Cost
BETTERREWARDS-RELIC_BASE_COST.hover.desc: Gold cost for the first random relic purchase.
BETTERREWARDS-RELIC_COST_SCALING.title: Random Relic Cost Scaling
BETTERREWARDS-RELIC_COST_SCALING.hover.d: Multiplier applied to relic cost after each purchase.
BETTERREWARDS-RANDOM_ITEM.title: Random item
BETTERREWARDS-RANDOM_ITEM_BASE_COST.hove: Gold cost for the first random item purchase.
BETTERREWARDS-RANDOM_ITEM_COST_SCALING.h: Multiplier applied to random item cost after each purchase.
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_TYPE_WEIGHTS.title: Item type weights
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_RELIC.title: Item Type Weight: Relic
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_RELIC.hover.de: Relative weight for the random item to be a relic.
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_CARD.title: Item Type Weight: Card
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_CARD.hover.des: Relative weight for the random item to be a card.
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_POTION.title: Item Type Weight: Potion
BETTERREWARDS-ITEM_WEIGHT_POTION.hover.d: Relative weight for the random item to be a potion.
